content.title: SUNation Energy: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: RONKONKOMA, N.Y. (AP) — SUNation Energy Inc (SUNE) on Friday reported a loss of $393,000 in its third quarter. The Ronkonkoma, New York-based company said it had a loss of 12 cents per share. The broadband network services company posted revenue of $19 million in the period.

content.summary: RONKONKOMA, N.Y. (AP) — SUNation Energy Inc (SUNE) on Friday reported a loss of $9.6 million in its second quarter.
